meta.title: Assign is disabled when a selected item is partly used

plan.title: Assign disabled for partly used PR item

steps.note: Stay on the Open tab where PR-5 can be sourced.

args.goal: search for PR-5, select its partly used line item, hover the Assign control, and verify that Assign is disabled with the tooltip "No open items selected" and that the selected row's Assignee cell cannot be changed

steps.note: Perform and observe the item-level selection and assignment restrictions.
Assert that the Assign control is disabled.
Assert the required tooltip explains why assignment is unavailable.
